content.description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role
We’re looking for a Full-stack Software Development Engineer (SDE-2) who brings strong engineering fundamentals, a product mindset, and a bias for action. This role is ideal for someone who takes end-to-end ownership, thrives on building impactful, user-centric features, and is excited by the opportunity to innovate and drive improvements across the stack.You’ll work closely with product, design, and platform teams to deliver features that are data-driven, performant, and scalable. You’ll be expected to contribute ideas, propose solutions, and lead execution—from concept to deployment.
Responsibilities
Own the full lifecycle of features: from requirements gathering and UI/UX collaboration to backend API integration and deployment

Collaborate closely with product and design to shape features that solve real user problems

Implement clean, performant, and accessible UI using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend practices

Build and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js/Express, with well-designed APIs and data models

Use analytics and product metrics to measure feature success and iterate for improvement

Take initiative to improve engineering processes, dev experience, or user experience

Maintain code quality through thoughtful architecture, testing, and documentation

Proactively address technical debt and participate in refactor or migration efforts

Actively contribute to planning and execute reliably under fast-moving product priorities
Requirements
3–5 years of fullstack development experience

Experience in taking features or systems from 0 → 1, and seeing them through to adoption

Strong command over JavaScript/TypeScript, Vue.js, modern state management, and component-based architecture

Deep knowledge of Node.js, REST APIs, and databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, etc.)

Product intuition: ability to weigh trade-offs, collaborate with PM/design, and advocate for users

Passion for metrics and data-driven decisions—you care about impact, not just delivery

Clear communicator and collaborator, comfortable working across teams

A track record of taking initiative to solve problems beyond what’s assigned
#LI-Remote #LI-RS1
